new_claims.summary: If the actual spectral projection P=1_{|A|>=1/96} has rank 3, define H={P_ii>1/32}. Either the surviving Gram on H^c has lambda_min>=1/2, in which case account02/B08 perturbative diffuse stability yields a continuous C_0 density with ||p_Q||inf<(864/25)sqrt(3e)<99, or a unit high-spectral direction has >1/2 mass on H with |H|<=95.
Pay the branch with >1/2 high-spectral mass on <=95 physical coordinates while retaining an arbitrary dense spectral tail of norm <1/96 and the remaining spread high-spectral directions.

important_scope: Uses actual spectral projector, so repeated eigenvalues/eigenbasis choices do not affect leverage or heavy set.
Dense low-spectrum tail is paid through the physical-coordinate partner theorem, not discarded by characteristic-function perturbation.
Continuity is proved only in the diffuse branch; full target and full continuity remain open.
Do not infer a density theorem from bounded-cardinality localization alone.
